audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 7.5/10 with tone TRICKY reads as a losing lane, but the win rate is 55.29% over 170 games and the content layer says outright 'This is your lane to take'. The difficulty label and the lane text disagree.
audit.why: Neeko has no all-in without Pop Blossom, her Blooming Burst is a single-target poke against a champion whose Happy Hour heals on every cast, and Gragas has the harder level-6 all-in. Nothing in either kit supports a 7.5/10.
audit.corrected: Left unchanged pending the user's call — recorded in questionsForUser rather than flipped, because diffRating, tone, diff and breakdown.difficulty all have to move together with the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradict both the packet levelChart and their own why-text. Level 1 is given to Neeko while whys[0] says 'farm even'; Level 2 is 'Skill' while whys[1] says 'step up the instant it comes online'; Level 6 is given to Neeko while whys[4] says 'E-W-Q runs her down'; and 2+ items is Gragas while whys[6] says 'the edge swings to her'. Both layers carry all four.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Skill. Mechanically: Pop Blossom is a 120s rank-1 engage stun with a visible preparation, so level 6 favours the champion with the 100s Explosive Cask and a stun dash; the late swing to Neeko is teamfight pick pressure, not a 1v1 reclaim, which is why it lands on Skill and not Neeko.
audit.corrected: win[0] to Skill, win[1] to Gragas, win[4] to Gragas, win[6] to Skill; phases[0].side to Skill, phases[1].side to Gragas, phases[4].side to Gragas, phases[6].side to Skill, with ratings and why-text moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never states the two interactions that decide the lane: Tangle-Barbs roots for longer once it has passed through a champion (so eating it second is worse than eating it first), and Explosive Cask's knockback direction is the whole level-6 all-in. dontsFull[1] is even titled 'Throw R the wrong direction' but its body is generic cooldown boilerplate that never says which direction. Body Slam is also misquoted at 13 seconds.
audit.why: enemyKit E: 'If the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer', cd 12/11.5/11/10.5/10. ownerKit R knocks back, so casting it behind her drives her toward you; cd 100/85/70. ownerKit E cd 14s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Name the 12s rank-1 Tangle-Barbs and its growth, say Cask goes BEHIND her, and correct Body Slam to 14 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Neeko 'he' and 'his' throughout the templated fields (tradeGood, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[1].d, report[11]).
audit.why: Neeko is female; the content layer already uses 'she'. The mismatch is visible on the page.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tradeGood and dosFull[1].d; the composite breakdown/report strings still carry it.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Neeko contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One ability each and no Happy Hour yet, but Blooming Burst is only poke — farm even and set up your level 2.

edits.before: W damage reduction + sustain flips his return trade. Only take the trade when Neeko's Tangle-Barbs is down.
edits.after: Q+W gives a Drunken Rage auto plus Happy Hour that out-trades Blooming Burst chip — step up now.

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Neeko's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: E-W-Q runs her down, and Explosive Cask dropped BEHIND her knocks her into you rather than to safety. Pop Blossom is a 120s engage, not an escape.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Neeko carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: She turns into a teamfight pick threat with Pop Blossom and Shapesplitter flanks — close it out before the 5v5 decides instead.

edits.before: Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 and roots longer through a champion — dodge it, then go.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Cask behind her knocks her into you; in front flings her clear for 100s.

edits.before: Q-poke Neeko on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Q-poke Neeko on cooldown from fog angles, W as she answers, and E-slam only once Tangle-Barbs is down.

edits.after: Body Slam into a live Tangle-Barbs — a whiffed E is 14 seconds rooted in her poke.

notes: packet.defects claims the page 'never names any of Neeko's abilities' — that is only true of the full layer; the content layer names Blooming Burst behaviour, the E root, W clone and R stun in prose, and the full layer does use Tangle-Barbs.
